stores.purpose: Bounded upload scanning/encryption and coordinated ciphertext materialization
stores.protection: Memory-first intake; encrypted payloads in private temporary staging; no plaintext database dump files
stores.retention: Request/job-scoped cleanup; process crash can leave orphaned ciphertext for reviewed reconciliation
stores.assurance: Scanner availability/signatures, host temporary storage and quota monitoring need owner evidence

stores.protection: Authenticated SHMSBKP1 envelope under a separate backup key; file-only bucket credential; exact-cloud-download recovery gate
stores.retention: Latest daily point for seven distinct UTC dates and first successful snapshot for three UTC monthly periods; older PGP snapshot is outside managed names
stores.assurance: Completed November 1 cloud/application drills are recorded; preserve both keys separately and observe future timed executions

stores.purpose: Operational diagnosis without clinical request payloads
stores.protection: Allowlisted/sanitized metadata; finite rotated logs; no guarantee supplied for provider log-store encryption
stores.retention: Application transport rotation is bounded; hosting log retention needs provider/operator policy
stores.assurance: Owner must verify provider logging destination, access, encryption and expiry

stores.protection: Dedicated metrics bearer secret and private observability overlay; no clinical scrape payload
stores.retention: Bounded configured metrics retention; provider deployment and receiver configuration remain pending

stores.purpose: Account verification, invitations and selected notifications
stores.protection: Configured SMTP requires verified TLS in production; recipient delivery is separate evidence
stores.retention: Mailbox/provider retention and deletion follow approved provider/organization policy, not clinical disposal code
stores.assurance: No actual SMTP receipt is claimed; configure reviewed recipients and provider arrangements

stores.protection: Authenticated internal service with process-local bounded session state; external model calls require explicit configuration/review
stores.retention: Short-lived process-local memory; separately persisted triage rows need approved retention policy
stores.assurance: AI provider operation, data handling, clinical validation and multi-instance behavior require owner review

stores.purpose: Decrypt application fields and independently encrypted archives
stores.protection: Keys remain separate from B2 payloads; backup worker has only the application-key fingerprint
stores.retention: Preserve original keys for retained ciphertext; rotation/re-encryption is an outstanding operational engineering concern
stores.assurance: Protected off-host key custody and recovery/rotation evidence require the operator
